hero.heading:
Bringing Ethereum to campuses
ahead of Devcon 8
hero.body: The Academic Program helped shape the next generation of Ethereum builders on campus and brought university communities to Devcon in Mumbai.

items.title: Campuses on the Road to Devcon
items.body: Every meetup was part of a global series building toward Devcon 8. Hosting one made each university part of that story, and got its community there first.

items.title: Finding their people ahead of Devcon India
items.body: Students connected with researchers, developers, and protocol contributors who share their enthusiasm, and their obsessions.

items.title: Campuses as classrooms for Ethereum
items.body: The expertise was already there: professors, researchers, and builders in each university working on the hardest problems in the space.

who_can_apply.heading: Who could apply
who_can_apply.intro: We supported initiatives such as introductory talks, technical workshops, panel discussions, research presentations, hackathons, or meetups that:
bullets: Align with Ethereum's core values, including censorship resistance, open source, privacy, and security
Contribute to the Ethereum ecosystem's growth
Took place between 15 May and 15 October, 2026

what_you_can_receive.heading: What campuses received
bullets: Up to $300 USD in financial support per event
Devcon tickets (free or discounted) for faculty and top student applicants
Amplification of your event through Devcon channels
